picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim that an AI system produced an analytic proof and Lean formalization addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem — using ~10,000 autonomous AI agents — would be one of the most significant AI-for-mathematics results to date if verified, with major implications for AI-assisted proof discovery.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, discussed at the National Academy of Engineering's annual meeting, aims to connect national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-science infrastructure — a potentially field-defining federal initiative.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated LHC collisions marks a major convergence of frontier AI companies and big science, with potential to reshape how particle physics discovery is done.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: Vanderbilt's role as a founding member of the White House-announced Southeast Regional Superintelligence Computing Consortium signals a coordinated federal push to build shared advanced-computing infrastructure across 14+ universities — a notable shift in how AI research capacity is organized regionally.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: Brown's involvement in the $28.6 million multi-institution NATIVE-ID project, which pairs machine learning with protein-misfolding research, represents a substantial federal investment in AI-driven neurodegenerative disease science.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: UCF's $19.2 million Army Research Office award to study light propagation through complex environments, combining optical sensing with computational and AI-driven inverse methods, is a significant defense-backed investment in AI-enabled physical science.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: Arkansas's AURORA project, part of a $20 million NSF-led effort to build a robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory for discovering quantum materials, exemplifies how AI and automation are accelerating materials science.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work developing probes to detect internal model activity that precedes unsafe or misaligned AI behavior — motivated by a real 2026 incident — speaks directly to the urgent policy question of how to monitor frontier AI systems for harm before deployment.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: University of Florida's leadership of the State Department-funded Feed the Future Innovation Lab builds an international, AI-enabled biosecurity network spanning seven countries, linking academic AI research directly to U.S. foreign policy and food-security goals.
picks.title: University of Florida to lead new Feed the Future Innovation Lab for High-Value Crops

picks.editorial_note: UCT's $1.6 million Google.org grant to build an AI platform mapping genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients extends AI-for-science funding into an underrepresented research population, with real potential to improve treatment outcomes.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs
